can_answer: yes: the file has annual crash-level counts of cyclist and motorist deaths, so these can be summed by crash year and compared as counts; it cannot measure individual risk or exposure-adjusted rates
metric: annual number of cyclist deaths and annual number of motorist deaths, separately
population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash rows dated from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; each crash contributes its cyclist-killed and motorist-killed counts
filters: crash_date falls in calendar years 2013 through 2025

data_check_plan.population_counts: Count the qualifying crash rows overall and per year; inspect whether first or last year is partial based on the observed date coverage.

columns.crash_date: Check qualifying rows for missing, invalid, or out-of-range dates and the observed date coverage by year.
columns.number_of_cyclist_killed: Among qualifying rows, count missing values, zero values (the default/zero pile-up), and impossible negative values.
columns.number_of_motorist_killed: Among qualifying rows, count missing values, zero values (the default/zero pile-up), and impossible negative values.

data_check_plan.outcome_results: Do not calculate death totals, rates, or shares during the check.

check_implications_and_decisions.dates: The planned rows number 2,132,218; each year 2013-2025 has observed dates spanning January 1 through December 31, so no year is shortened based on the observed endpoints. The date field is a DATE and the year filter assigns every included row to a calendar year.
check_implications_and_decisions.number_of_cyclist_killed: There are no missing or negative values. The field is zero on 2,131,942 of the 2,132,218 rows; retain these rows as zero cyclist deaths for that crash, rather than dropping the large and valid zero pile-up.
check_implications_and_decisions.number_of_motorist_killed: There are no missing or negative values. The field is zero on 2,130,945 of the 2,132,218 rows; retain these rows as zero motorist deaths for that crash, rather than dropping the large and valid zero pile-up.
check_implications_and_decisions.change_to_plan: No change to years, population, metric, or grouping. Keep all dated crash rows in 2013-2025 and sum the two fatality count fields independently by year.

limitations: These are counts of deaths recorded on police-reported NYC crash records, not population- or travel-exposure-adjusted risks. The observed date endpoints span each calendar year; the checks found no missing or negative fatality values. The many zero-valued crash-level entries are retained as valid crashes with no deaths of that road-user group.
